purpose: Exercise two fixed M-reliability optimizer updates after the family-relative anonymous rule runs over the complete registered metadata clocks of the first two policy Train videos.
selection_rule: Use the first two frozen policy-order videos and every metadata clock frame available for each; consume the full fixed clock even after the two registered M updates, with no outcome-based selection.
interpretation: This is bounded full-clock optimizer/interface evidence for the M branch on policy Train cache. It is not predicted-track training, calibrated memory, an OCD/MOT metric, or Goal A/B/C acceptance.
